---- MODULE W4Od17m9p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Routers, MaxEpoch
None == "none"
VARIABLES owner, serving, epoch, believed, adminLock
vars == <<owner, serving, epoch, believed, adminLock>>

TypeInv ==
    /\ owner \in Routers \cup {None}
    /\ serving \in [Routers -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ believed \in [Routers -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ adminLock \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ owner = None
    /\ serving = [r \in Routers |-> FALSE]
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ believed = [r \in Routers |-> 0]
    /\ adminLock = FALSE

Acquire(r) ==
    /\ owner = None
    /\ ~adminLock
    /\ believed[r] = epoch
    /\ ~serving[r]
    /\ owner' = r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<serving, epoch, believed, adminLock>>

BeginServe(r) ==
    /\ owner = r
    /\ ~serving[r]
    /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, epoch, believed, adminLock>>

EndServe(r) ==
    /\ owner = r
    /\ serving[r]
    /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ owner' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, believed, adminLock>>

Release(r) ==
    /\ owner = r
    /\ ~serving[r]
    /\ owner' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<serving, epoch, believed, adminLock>>

Refresh(r) ==
    /\ believed[r] # epoch
    /\ believed' = [believed EXCEPT ![r] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, serving, epoch, adminLock>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ owner' = None
    /\ serving' = [r \in Routers |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<believed, adminLock>>

AdminSeize ==
    /\ ~adminLock
    /\ adminLock' = TRUE
    /\ owner' = None
    /\ serving' = [r \in Routers |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, believed>>

AdminRelease ==
    /\ adminLock
    /\ adminLock' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, serving, epoch, believed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Acquire(r) \/ BeginServe(r) \/ EndServe(r)
                          \/ Release(r) \/ Refresh(r)
    \/ Reconfigure \/ AdminSeize \/ AdminRelease

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BeltExclusive ==
    /\ (adminLock => owner = None)
    /\ (\A r \in Routers : serving[r] => owner = r)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Routers = {r1, r2, r3}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BeltExclusive
nl:
An airport baggage router coordinates several sortation routers that all feed one shared merge belt, the single critical resource that only one router may drive at a time. The system runs in numbered configuration epochs; whenever the layout is reconfigured the epoch counter advances, the belt is cleared, and every router must resync its epoch before it may act again. A router may claim the belt only when it is free, the router's believed epoch matches the current epoch, and no admin override is active. Once it holds the belt the router begins serving bags, then finishes and releases. A privileged admin can seize control at any moment: doing so takes the belt away from whoever held it, clears all active serving, and raises an override lock that blocks every router until the admin releases it. Routers may refresh their believed epoch to the live value at any time. Reconfiguration and admin seizure both reset serving so no stale router keeps driving the belt.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At any instant at most one router is actively driving the merge belt, and no router drives it while the admin override lock is engaged.

---- MODULE W4Od18m8p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Residents, Doors, MaxEpoch
None == "none"
VARIABLES zoneOwner, doorOwner, epoch, cred, capacity
vars == <<zoneOwner, doorOwner, epoch, cred, capacity>>

Locked == {d \in Doors : doorOwner[d] # None}

TypeInv ==
    /\ zoneOwner \in Residents \cup {None}
    /\ doorOwner \in [Doors -> Residents \cup {None}]
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ cred \in [Residents -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ capacity \in 1..Cardinality(Doors)

Init ==
    /\ zoneOwner = None
    /\ doorOwner = [d \in Doors |-> None]
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ cred = [p \in Residents |-> 0]
    /\ capacity = Cardinality(Doors)

AcquireZone(p) ==
    /\ zoneOwner = None
    /\ cred[p] = epoch
    /\ zoneOwner' = p
    /\ UNCHANGED <<doorOwner, epoch, cred, capacity>>

ReleaseZone(p) ==
    /\ zoneOwner = p
    /\ \A d \in Doors : doorOwner[d] # p
    /\ zoneOwner' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<doorOwner, epoch, cred, capacity>>

LockDoor(p, d) ==
    /\ zoneOwner = p
    /\ cred[p] = epoch
    /\ doorOwner[d] = None
    /\ Cardinality(Locked) < capacity
    /\ doorOwner' = [doorOwner EXCEPT ![d] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneOwner, epoch, cred, capacity>>

UnlockDoor(p, d) ==
    /\ doorOwner[d] = p
    /\ doorOwner' = [doorOwner EXCEPT ![d] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneOwner, epoch, cred, capacity>>

Refresh(p) ==
    /\ cred[p] # epoch
    /\ cred' = [cred EXCEPT ![p] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneOwner, doorOwner, epoch, capacity>>

RotateEpoch ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ zoneOwner' = None
    /\ doorOwner' = [d \in Doors |-> None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cred, capacity>>

ChangeCapacity ==
    /\ \E c \in 1..Cardinality(Doors) : capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneOwner, doorOwner, epoch, cred>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Residents : AcquireZone(p) \/ ReleaseZone(p) \/ Refresh(p)
    \/ \E p \in Residents, d \in Doors : LockDoor(p, d) \/ UnlockDoor(p, d)
    \/ RotateEpoch \/ ChangeCapacity

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

HierarchyAuthorized ==
    \A d \in Doors :
        doorOwner[d] # None =>
            /\ doorOwner[d] = zoneOwner
            /\ cred[doorOwner[d]] = epoch
====

CONSTANTS
    Residents = {a, b}
    Doors = {d1, d2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT HierarchyAuthorized
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network guards a zone containing several doors using two-level hierarchical locking: a resident must first take the coarse zone lock, and only then may take the fine lock on an individual door. Each resident carries a credential stamped with an epoch; the hub can rotate the epoch at any time, which immediately invalidates the whole locking state and forces every credential to be refreshed before use. A resident with a current credential may claim the free zone lock, then lock individual free doors up to a live capacity limit that the hub can raise or lower at runtime. A resident may unlock its own doors and, once holding none, release the zone. Rotating the epoch clears the zone owner and all door locks so no stale resident keeps holding anything. A resident whose credential is out of date, or who never took the zone lock, must not hold any door.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every locked door is held by the resident that currently owns the zone lock and whose credential matches the live epoch.

---- MODULE W4Od2m3p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Robots, MaxTerm
None == "none"
VARIABLES leader, term, status, known, actedBy
vars == <<leader, term, status, known, actedBy>>

TypeInv ==
    /\ leader \in Robots \cup {None}
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ status \in [Robots -> {"up", "down"}]
    /\ known \in [Robots -> 0..MaxTerm]
    /\ actedBy \in Robots \cup {None}

Init ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ term = 0
    /\ status = [r \in Robots |-> "up"]
    /\ known = [r \in Robots |-> 0]
    /\ actedBy = None

Elect(r) ==
    /\ status[r] = "up"
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = r
    /\ known' = [known EXCEPT ![r] = term + 1]
    /\ actedBy' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED status

SyncTerm(r) ==
    /\ status[r] = "up"
    /\ known[r] # term
    /\ known' = [known EXCEPT ![r] = term]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, status, actedBy>>

Act(r) ==
    /\ leader = r
    /\ status[r] = "up"
    /\ known[r] = term
    /\ actedBy' = r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, status, known>>

Crash(r) ==
    /\ status[r] = "up"
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![r] = "down"]
    /\ leader' = (IF leader = r THEN None ELSE leader)
    /\ actedBy' = (IF leader = r THEN None ELSE actedBy)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, known>>

Recover(r) ==
    /\ status[r] = "down"
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![r] = "up"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, known, actedBy>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Elect(r) \/ SyncTerm(r) \/ Act(r) \/ Crash(r) \/ Recover(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleActor ==
    actedBy = None \/
        /\ actedBy = leader
        /\ status[actedBy] = "up"
        /\ known[actedBy] = term
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Robots = {r1, r2, r3}
    MaxTerm = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleActor
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet keeps one elected leader that issues picking commands to the floor. Leadership is tracked by a monotonically increasing term number: any up robot may stand for election by starting the next term, at which point it becomes leader and stamps its own knowledge of the term. Robots may crash silently at any time, going down without warning; if the leader is the one that crashes, the fleet is immediately left without a leader. A down robot may later recover. Only the current leader, while up and with its known term equal to the live term, may perform a fleet action, and the identity of the acting robot is recorded. Whenever the term advances through a new election, or the leader crashes, the record of who last acted is cleared, so no deposed or stale robot is ever left standing as the recorded actor. Non-leader robots may sync their known term up to the live value.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The recorded last actor, when present, is the current up leader whose known term equals the live term.

EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Students, MaxVer, MaxSeats
None == "none"
VARIABLES version, holder, holderVer, snap, capacity, taken
vars == <<version, holder, holderVer, snap, capacity, taken>>

TypeInv ==

    /\ holder \in Students \cup {None}
    /\ holderVer \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ snap \in [Students -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxSeats
    /\ taken \in 0..MaxSeats

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ holder = None
    /\ holderVer = 0
    /\ snap = [s \in Students |-> 0]
    /\ capacity = MaxSeats
    /\ taken = 0

Read(s) ==
    /\ snap[s] # version
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![s] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, holder, holderVer, capacity, taken>>

Acquire(s) ==
    /\ holder = None
    /\ snap[s] = version
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ holder' = s
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ holderVer' = version + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, capacity, taken>>

Edit(s) ==
    /\ holder = s
    /\ taken < capacity
    /\ taken' = taken + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, holder, holderVer, snap, capacity>>

Release(s) ==
    /\ holder = s
    /\ holder' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, holderVer, snap, capacity, taken>>

ChangeCapacity ==
    /\ \E c \in 0..MaxSeats : capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, holder, holderVer, snap, taken>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Students : Read(s) \/ Acquire(s) \/ Edit(s) \/ Release(s)
    \/ ChangeCapacity

TokenVersionFresh ==
    holder = None \/ holderVer = version
====

CONSTANTS
    Students = {s1, s2}
    MaxVer = 3
    MaxSeats = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TokenVersionFresh
nl:
A university course-registration system serializes edits to a course roster through a single compare-and-swap edit token backed by a version register. A student process first reads the current version into its local snapshot. To gain the token it performs a compare-and-swap: it may take the free token only if its snapshot still equals the live version, and the successful swap bumps the version and stamps the token's version to the new value. Only the process currently holding the token may edit the roster, adding a seat while the number taken stays below a capacity that the registrar can raise or lower at runtime. The holder eventually releases the token. Because every acquisition advances the version, any process whose snapshot has gone stale simply fails its compare-and-swap and must re-read, so no stale process can seize the token.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever the edit token is held, the token's stamped version equals the live version register.

---- MODULE W4Od7m0p2t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Cranes, Total, MaxVer
VARIABLES onShip, onYard, carrying, version, snap, capacity
vars == <<onShip, onYard, carrying, version, snap, capacity>>

TypeInv ==
    /\ onShip \in 0..Total
    /\ onYard \in 0..Total
    /\ carrying \in SUBSET Cranes
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ snap \in [Cranes -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ capacity \in 0..Total

Init ==
    /\ onShip = Total
    /\ onYard = 0
    /\ carrying = {}
    /\ version = 0
    /\ snap = [c \in Cranes |-> 0]
    /\ capacity = Total

ReadVer(c) ==
    /\ snap[c] # version
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onShip, onYard, carrying, version, capacity>>

Pick(c) ==
    /\ c \notin carrying
    /\ onShip > 0
    /\ carrying' = carrying \cup {c}
    /\ onShip' = onShip - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onYard, version, snap, capacity>>

CommitToYard(c) ==
    /\ c \in carrying
    /\ snap[c] = version
    /\ onYard < capacity
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ carrying' = carrying \ {c}
    /\ onYard' = onYard + 1
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onShip, snap, capacity>>

PutBack(c) ==
    /\ c \in carrying
    /\ carrying' = carrying \ {c}
    /\ onShip' = onShip + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onYard, version, snap, capacity>>

Rebalance ==
    /\ onYard > 0
    /\ onShip < Total
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ onYard' = onYard - 1
    /\ onShip' = onShip + 1
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<carrying, snap, capacity>>

ChangeCapacity ==
    /\ \E k \in 0..Total : capacity' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onShip, onYard, carrying, version, snap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : ReadVer(c) \/ Pick(c) \/ CommitToYard(c) \/ PutBack(c)
    \/ Rebalance \/ ChangeCapacity

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ContainerConservation ==
    onShip + onYard + Cardinality(carrying) = Total
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {c1, c2}
    Total = 3
    MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ContainerConservation
nl:
A container-ship crane yard moves a fixed population of containers between a ship and a yard using cranes that coordinate through optimistic locking. Each crane first reads the yard's version stamp into a snapshot. A crane with empty hands may pick a container off the ship, then attempt to commit it into the yard: the commit succeeds only if the crane's snapshot still matches the live yard version and the yard is below its capacity, and a successful commit advances the yard version. If a crane discovers its snapshot is stale it re-reads and retries. A crane may also abort by putting its held container back on the ship. A separate rebalancing move can shuttle a container from the yard back to the ship, which also advances the version and can invalidate in-flight snapshots. The yard capacity can be adjusted at runtime. No container is ever created or destroyed; every container is on the ship, in the yard, or momentarily in a crane's grip.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of containers on the ship, in the yard, and held by cranes always sums to the fixed total.

---- MODULE W4Od18m6p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Owners, MaxVal, MaxTime, Lifetime
None == "none"
VARIABLES value, writes, leaseHolder, expiry, clock, base, capacity
vars == <<value, writes, leaseHolder, expiry, clock, base, capacity>>

TypeInv ==
    /\ value \in 0..MaxVal
    /\ writes \in 0..MaxVal
    /\ leaseHolder \in Owners \cup {None}
    /\ expiry \in 0..MaxTime
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxTime
    /\ base \in [Owners -> 0..MaxVal]
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxVal

Init ==
    /\ value = 0
    /\ writes = 0
    /\ leaseHolder = None
    /\ expiry = 0
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ base = [o \in Owners |-> 0]
    /\ capacity = MaxVal

AcquireLease(o) ==
    /\ leaseHolder = None
    /\ leaseHolder' = o
    /\ expiry' = IF clock + Lifetime <= MaxTime THEN clock + Lifetime ELSE MaxTime
    /\ UNCHANGED <<value, writes, clock, base, capacity>>

ReadBase(o) ==
    /\ leaseHolder = o
    /\ base[o] # value
    /\ base' = [base EXCEPT ![o] = value]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<value, writes, leaseHolder, expiry, clock, capacity>>

Commit(o) ==
    /\ leaseHolder = o
    /\ clock <= expiry
    /\ base[o] = value
    /\ value < capacity
    /\ value' = base[o] + 1
    /\ writes' = writes + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, expiry, clock, base, capacity>>

ReleaseLease(o) ==
    /\ leaseHolder = o
    /\ leaseHolder' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<value, writes, expiry, clock, base, capacity>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxTime
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ leaseHolder' = IF clock + 1 > expiry THEN None ELSE leaseHolder
    /\ UNCHANGED <<value, writes, expiry, base, capacity>>

ChangeCapacity ==
    /\ \E k \in 0..MaxVal : capacity' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<value, writes, leaseHolder, expiry, clock, base>>

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Owners : AcquireLease(o) \/ ReadBase(o) \/ Commit(o) \/ ReleaseLease(o)
    \/ Tick \/ ChangeCapacity

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
    value = writes
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Owners = {o1, o2}
    MaxVal = 2
    MaxTime = 2
    Lifetime = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network keeps a shared configuration record that stores an integer setting, and coordinates edits through a lease with an expiry. An owner may take the free lease, receiving an expiry a fixed lifetime into the future measured on a shared clock. To edit, the owner first reads the record's current value into a local base. It may then commit a new value only while its lease has not expired and its base still equals the live value; the committed value is its base plus one, and a running count of successful writes is kept. If a concurrent commit has advanced the value, the owner's base is stale and its own commit is blocked until it re-reads, so no update is ever silently overwritten and lost. The clock ticks forward and a lease past its expiry is dropped. The record's capacity ceiling can be adjusted at runtime, and the lease may be released explicitly.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The stored value always equals the number of successful writes, so no committed update is ever lost.

---- MODULE W4Od2m8p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Robots
None == "none"
VARIABLES aisleOwner, bayOwner, inBay, pending
vars == <<aisleOwner, bayOwner, inBay, pending>>

TypeInv ==
    /\ aisleOwner \in Robots \cup {None}
    /\ bayOwner \in Robots \cup {None}
    /\ inBay \in [Robots -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ pending \in SUBSET Robots

Init ==
    /\ aisleOwner = None
    /\ bayOwner = None
    /\ inBay = [r \in Robots |-> FALSE]
    /\ pending = {}

Request(r) ==
    /\ r \notin pending
    /\ aisleOwner # r
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aisleOwner, bayOwner, inBay>>

GrantAisle(r) ==
    /\ aisleOwner = None
    /\ r \in pending
    /\ aisleOwner' = r
    /\ pending' = pending \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bayOwner, inBay>>

GrantBay(r) ==
    /\ aisleOwner = r
    /\ bayOwner = None
    /\ bayOwner' = r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aisleOwner, inBay, pending>>

Enter(r) ==
    /\ bayOwner = r
    /\ ~inBay[r]
    /\ inBay' = [inBay EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aisleOwner, bayOwner, pending>>

Leave(r) ==
    /\ inBay[r]
    /\ inBay' = [inBay EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ bayOwner' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aisleOwner, pending>>

ReleaseAisle(r) ==
    /\ aisleOwner = r
    /\ bayOwner # r
    /\ aisleOwner' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bayOwner, inBay, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Request(r) \/ GrantAisle(r) \/ GrantBay(r)
                         \/ Enter(r) \/ Leave(r) \/ ReleaseAisle(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BayMutex ==
    \A r \in Robots :
        inBay[r] => (bayOwner = r /\ aisleOwner = r)
====

CONSTANTS
    Robots = {r1, r2, r3}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BayMutex
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet shares a single charging bay that only one robot may occupy at a time. Access is granted through two-level hierarchical locking: a robot must first be granted the aisle lock, then the bay lock, before it may enter the bay. Robots post their access requests into an unordered request pool, and the coordinator may grant the aisle to any pending requester in any order, so messages are effectively reordered in flight. Holding the aisle, a robot may take the free bay lock, then physically enter the bay and charge; on leaving it releases the bay, and it may release the aisle once it no longer holds the bay. Because entering requires holding the bay lock and the bay lock is single-valued, the bay never holds two robots at once. Robots repeatedly request, charge, and leave.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one robot occupies the charging bay at any time, and any occupant currently holds both its bay lock and the enclosing aisle lock.

    /\ copyLock' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<avail, reserved, checkedOut, catalogLock>>

====

CONSTANTS
    Instances = {b1, b2}
    Total = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CopiesConserved
nl:
A library book-reservation system runs two independent branch instances that share a single pool of physical copies. Every copy is always in exactly one of three states: available on the shelf, reserved for a patron, or checked out. To move any copy between states a branch must take two hierarchical locks in order: first the coarse catalog lock, then the fine per-copy lock. Holding both locks, a branch may reserve an available copy, check out a reserved copy, or return a checked-out copy back to available. A branch releases the copy lock when done and the catalog lock once it no longer holds the copy lock. Because the two branches draw from and return to the same shared pool, and every transition just relabels one copy, the total number of copies can never change. Copies are never conjured or lost, only moved among the three states.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of available, reserved, and checked-out copies always sums to the fixed total pool size.

---- MODULE W4Od13m9p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Machines, MaxEpoch, MaxStock
None == "none"
VARIABLES epoch, known, lastVendor, stock, capacity
vars == <<epoch, known, lastVendor, stock, capacity>>

TypeInv ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ known \in [Machines -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ lastVendor \in Machines \cup {None}
    /\ stock \in 0..MaxStock
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxStock

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ known = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
    /\ lastVendor = None
    /\ stock = MaxStock
    /\ capacity = MaxStock

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ lastVendor' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<known, stock, capacity>>

Resync(m) ==

It may dispense a still-pending prescription only if its snapshot still equals the live version and at least one medication unit remains; dispensing consumes one unit, marks the prescription dispensed, and advances the version.
